title: The unit of the affine derived adjunction is invertible
statement: Let A be a commutative ring and adj : F ⊣ G with F : D(A) → D_QCoh(Spec A), G : D_QCoh(Spec A) → D(A), using [def-pc-derived-category]. Assume Q followed by F and inclusion is naturally isomorphic to termwise tilde followed by Q, and G is naturally isomorphic to derived global sections with scalar transport [def-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-direct-image], [def-sc-ringed-space-module-cohomology], [lem-weil-pbc-affine-tilde-gamma-adjunction]. For every M in D(A), adj.unit_M is invertible.

proof.text: Apply the derived-category cohomology criterion: it suffices to prove that the unit induces an isomorphism on each integer-degree homology object.
